items.content_html: lupine.js is a full-featured web application that includes both Front-End and Back-End services. items.content_html: MonoAgent is a lightweight agent runtime with a Node main process. It uses Docker containers as a sandbox execution environment, SQLite for persistence, and runs pi-agent-core + pi-ai as the agent execution engine within the container. The system supports IM access, MCP protocol, asynchronous Cron scheduling.
